title: Motivation, LP connection, and the ${}^6\mathrm{He}$ worked count for the Frobenius filter
html:
Remark. Motivation, LP connection, and the {}^6\mathrm{He} worked count for the Frobenius filter

For nuclei with even mass number A, the raw character sum is negative. The physical Q-value is obtained by restricting the sum to Frobenius-positive configurations.

Connection to the confinement LP

The Frobenius positivity constraint provides the continuous analogue of the LP feasibility constraint Gx \geq 0. It acts as a configuration filter.

Computational complexity

For the {}^6\mathrm{He} \to {}^6\mathrm{Li} decay (A = 6), the 32 patterns with odd parity are excluded. The Frobenius-filtered sum yields Q \approx 3.637 MeV (experiment: 3.508 MeV, error +3.68\%). For large even A, the configurations require either enumeration or a closed-form simplification.
